issues.description: The foreground lead carries his rifle muzzle-down beside the brine rather than clear of the water at chest or shoulder height.

items.summary: The long-lens daylight salt-flat look and forward movement are strong, but the frame replaces the designed file with a broad massed formation. The brine is too deep, most troops incorrectly wear berets, the required salt-crusted wear is missing, and numerous AK-pattern rifles are malformed or lack the specified fixed wooden stocks.

issues.description: The soldiers advance as a broad multi-rank wall rather than the designed file extending toward the camera through telephoto compression.
issues.fix: Recompose the troops as a narrow single-file or tightly staggered column receding in depth, with the lead men approaching the camera.

issues.description: Most clearly visible commandos wear dark berets or caps, contradicting the production rule that they are bare-headed with short black hair.
issues.fix: Render all Egyptian commandos bare-headed with period-appropriate short black hair.

issues.description: Many overhead rifles lack clearly formed fixed wooden AKM stocks, and several weapons, slings and hands merge or intersect across the frame.
issues.fix: Regenerate each weapon as a coherent 1973 AKM with a fixed wooden stock, correct proportions and an independent natural two-hand grip.

issues.description: The brine reaches the soldiers' shins or knees instead of remaining at ankle depth.
issues.fix: Lower the brine to ankle depth while retaining modest splashes around their boots.

issues.description: The uniforms and faces look predominantly wet and muddy; the specified stiff grey clothing, dried white salt crust and salt crystals on skin and eyebrows are not clearly visible.
issues.fix: Add dried white salt crust to the greyed uniforms and restrained salt crystals to exposed skin and eyebrows.

issues.description: Firearms and equipment across the middle ground dissolve into garbled, repeated and physically merged shapes that will propagate during animation.
issues.fix: Re-render the crowd with individually resolved rifles, arms, straps and webbing, preserving clear separation between adjacent soldiers.

items.summary: Adel is convincingly photographed, proportionate, off-camera in gaze, and reasonably consistent with the casting portrait. However, the designed two-man trudging beat is reduced to an isolated static portrait: Mostafa is absent, and Adel's high-carried AKM is not visible. The prominent black synthetic/plastic-looking harness hardware also reads as modern rather than 1973 Soviet-pattern canvas webbing.

issues.description: Mostafa is absent, so the required image of Adel trudging beside him and trying to make him laugh is not established.
issues.fix: Re-render the same MCU with Mostafa visibly accompanying Adel at the edge or in the near middle ground while preserving Adel as the clear foreground speaker.

issues.description: Adel's high-carried AKM is completely outside the frame, undermining the action that must continue from this first frame.
issues.fix: Include a period-correct fixed-wood-stock AKM held clear of the brine at chest or shoulder height, with enough of it visible to support the following motion.

issues.description: The prominent black plastic/synthetic-looking chest and shoulder buckle assembly appears like modern tactical equipment rather than 1973 Soviet-pattern webbing.
issues.fix: Replace the modern-looking hardware with weathered khaki canvas Soviet-pattern straps, period metal fittings and appropriate magazine pouches.

issues.description: Mostafa appears immersed to roughly upper-thigh level in the middle ground, contradicting the specified ankle-deep salt-flat brine.
issues.fix: Re-render the men walking through a thin ankle-deep sheet of brine, with their trouser legs and boots visible above and through the shallow water.

issues.description: Adel's specified 9M14 Malyutka control box and periscope sight are not visibly carried in the frame.

issues.description: Mostafa and the distant finish-line markers are relatively distinct instead of falling into the soft background expected from an 85mm shallow-depth-of-field portrait shot.
issues.fix: Use shallower focus centred on Adel's face and upper torso so Mostafa and the distant flags fall noticeably softer.

issues.description: A cropped hand and congested weapon silhouette intrude at the extreme left edge, creating an unclear partial figure.

items.summary: The macro composition, sweaty hand, harsh daylight and blurred white salt-flat setting match the design, and the hand anatomy is convincing. The wrist also lacks the specified dried salt crystals.

issues.description: At the upper center of the stopwatch face, the minute subdial has garbled, irregular numerals and scale markings. This is clearly visible on the shot's hero prop.
issues.fix: Rebuild the upper subdial with clean, mechanically consistent period stopwatch numerals, tick marks and hands while preserving the existing main dial and casing.

items.summary: The insert composition, sweaty hand, bright salt-flat background, and period-style metal case fit the shot, but the stopwatch dial is visibly generated: it has garbled branding and an unexplained glyph, and its multiple separated central hands do not read as a convincing mechanical stopwatch display. issues.description: Garbled pseudo-brand text and a malformed glyph are plainly visible on the lower half of the stopwatch dial.

issues.description: The face has multiple separated central hands and does not clearly read as an authentic 1970s mechanical stopwatch display.

issues.description: The wrist is visibly sweaty, but the specified dried white salt crystals are not clearly present on the skin.

items.edit_instruction: Replace only the stopwatch dial with an authentic unbranded 1970s mechanical stopwatch face featuring clean tick marks, one central sweep-seconds hand and a coherent elapsed-minutes subdial; add a few subtle dried salt crystals to the wrist creases. items.summary: The composition, sweaty hand, harsh daylight and blurred salt-flat background match the insert design, and the five-digit grip appears natural. issues.description: At frame center, the hero stopwatch has malformed subdial scales and numerals plus ambiguous central-hand geometry, so it does not read as a properly functioning 1970s mechanical stopwatch.

issues.description: The tiny dial symbols and numerals are visibly garbled generated details in the sharpest and most narratively important part of the frame.

issues.description: The numerals and scale markings on both subdials are visibly garbled and inconsistent, which is especially noticeable because the dial is the shot's focal subject.

issues.description: The wrist is wet with sweat, but the specified dried white salt crust and visible salt crystals are largely absent.

The face does not match the attached actor and the direct camera gaze is unintended.

items.summary: The actor and broad 1973 desert setting are plausible, but the frame depicts a front-facing soldier casually standing on the road rather than the designed close-profile firing setup. He is not crouched in a sand pit, is not looking through the sight, and no Patton tank is present. The RPG-7 is malformed and lacks the required visible firing controls and PGO-7 sight, while the commando webbing, carrier bag, mud and salt wear are also absent.

issues.description: The central action and composition are wrong: C-03 stands frontally on the road instead of crouching in a shallow sand pit in close profile while aiming at a nearby tank.
issues.fix: Re-render from the specified behind-and-beside 85mm close-up, with C-03 crouched in the pit, cheek to the launcher and an Israeli Patton tank filling the soft background.

issues.description: The Israeli Patton tank that should fill the background beyond the warhead is completely absent.
issues.fix: Place a historically appropriate Israeli Patton tank crossing close by in the shallow-focus background beyond the loaded rocket.

issues.description: C-03 looks directly into the camera instead of turning in profile with his eye at the optical sight.
issues.fix: Turn his head and upper body naturally into the firing posture, with his gaze directed through the PGO-7 sight rather than toward the lens.

issues.description: The RPG-7 and loaded rocket are visibly incorrect: the launcher orientation and end geometry are confused, the PG-7V warhead is not correctly represented, and the PGO-7 sight and pistol-grip trigger are missing or unreadable.
issues.fix: Recreate a correctly proportioned RPG-7 with a loaded PG-7V projecting forward, a proper rear venturi, visible PGO-7 sight and pistol grip, positioned in a credible firing stance.

issues.description: The designed trigger action is absent; his hand merely supports the tube and no right index finger can be seen curling around a pistol-grip trigger.
issues.fix: Pose the right hand on the RPG-7 pistol grip with five natural fingers and the index finger beginning to tighten on the trigger.

issues.description: The Soviet-pattern magazine chest rig, web belt equipment, canteen and RPG rocket carrier bag specified for this 1973 Egyptian commando are absent.
issues.fix: Restore the correct Soviet-pattern canvas chest rig, web equipment, canteen and visible RPG carrier bag without introducing modern tactical gear.

issues.description: The uniform is clean and dry rather than caked with wet sand, salt and mud after the marsh crossing; the sleeves are also not rolled to the forearms as designed.
issues.fix: Add ingrained wet sand, pale salt residue, mud and grit throughout the uniform and equipment, and roll the sleeves naturally to the forearms.

issues.description: Soft, even illumination does not match the specified harsh desert daylight, hard shadows and heat haze.
issues.fix: Use strong high desert sun with deep directional shadows, bleached sand tones and subtle heat distortion around the distant tank and road.

issues.description: Faint vertical tonal bands appear in the sky at frame right.
issues.fix: Render a continuous natural sky gradient with restrained 35mm grain and no banding.

issues.description: C-03's visible eye looks toward the camera, while his face is too three-quarter/frontal for the designed profile aiming pose.

issues.description: The background tank's angular add-on armor and turret form resemble a later Magach/Sabra modernization rather than a 1973 Israeli Patton.
issues.fix: Replace it with a historically correct 1973 IDF Magach 3 or early Magach 6 configuration, without later ERA, wedge armor or modern fittings, and use verified 1973 tactical markings.

issues.description: The right index finger tightening on the RPG trigger—the next beat's key action—is not clearly visible in this first frame.

issues.description: The bag on C-03's back is a broad generic rucksack rather than the specified canvas RPG rocket carrier bag.

items.summary: The smoke, amber sun, flat desert and Sho't Kal-style tank are convincing, but the composition does not match the designed EWS. A large foreground tank and nearby visible crew dominate what should be a low, panoramic view of smoke columns extending along a distant straight road. The road is not clearly established, and the camera appears higher and closer than designed.

issues.description: The large foreground tank and nearby personnel dominate the frame, whereas the designed story point is an extreme-wide panorama of smoke columns extending along three kilometers of road with the amber sun behind them.
issues.fix: Recompose from a lower and substantially more distant 24mm viewpoint. Reduce tanks and personnel to small contextual elements while making the long sequence of smoke columns and amber sun the dominant image.

issues.description: The specified straight road is not clearly visible, so the smoke columns do not read as tracing a three-kilometer road corridor.
issues.fix: Clearly reveal a straight distant road running through the flat desert, with separate black and grey-white smoke columns distributed along its length.

issues.description: Two Israeli crewmen are visibly featured in the near-middle ground despite the production rule that Israeli crews are seen only at a distance.
issues.fix: Move the tank and crew far into the panorama so the crew remain anonymous distant silhouettes.

items.summary: The frame establishes an RPG team under smoky daylight and has convincing human proportions, but several conspicuous elements break the design and production rules. The rocket trails do not visually align with the team's aim toward the distant road, the central commando wears prohibited headgear, the PGO-7 sight appears incorrectly mounted, and the explicitly rock-free location is filled with coarse stones and rocky spoil.

issues.description: The two rocket streaks run diagonally toward the upper left while the foreground RPG is aimed to the right toward the distant road, preventing the volley from reading as fire from the depicted pits.
issues.fix: Re-render the rockets travelling away from the pits along the launcher team's line of fire, converging toward targets on the distant road.

issues.description: The central commando wears a patterned headband/head wrap, contrary to the production rule that Egyptian commandos are bare-headed with short black hair.
issues.fix: Remove the cloth headgear and show short, dusty black hair.

issues.description: The RPG-7's prominent optical sight appears placed on top of the tube rather than as a correctly shaped PGO-7 on the left-side mount.
issues.fix: Render a period-correct RPG-7 with the PGO-7 optical sight attached to its left-side bracket, while retaining the wooden heat shield, rear venturi and loaded PG-7V rocket.

issues.description: Numerous conspicuous rocks and coarse rubble fill the firing position, although this location is required to have no rocks and only shallow ripples in flat sand.
issues.fix: Replace the rocky spoil and stones with fine, flat desert sand, preserving only the deliberately dug firing pit and its low sandy lip.

references: real reference photo of prop PRP-0002 RPG-7 launcher

people.where: Foreground center-right, leaning over the missile system

items.summary: The actor and desert-war atmosphere are convincing, but the frame misses the designed shot: it is a medium close-up rather than an eye-and-sight close-up, and the operator is looking beside the sight instead of pressing his eye to it. His head also reads oversized against the narrow visible shoulders. The Malyutka launcher and guidance equipment appear incorrectly combined, and a modern-looking translucent screw-cap bottle is visible.

issues.description: The frame is a medium close-up showing the torso and most of the weapon system rather than the designed tight CU of the eye, sight and counting lips.
issues.fix: Re-render with an 85mm tight close-up centered on the operator's eye against the periscope, with his lips still visible and the launcher mostly outside the frame.

issues.description: C-06's eye is not pressed to the periscope; he looks past the right side of its housing instead of through it.
issues.fix: Place the correct eyepiece directly against his eye and align his gaze into the optic while keeping his lips available for the counting action.

issues.description: C-06 measures about 2.0 head widths across the projected shoulders, making his head look oversized for his thin adult body.
issues.fix: Reduce the head slightly or restore natural shoulder and upper-torso width so the shoulders read approximately 2.5–3 head widths across.

issues.description: The Malyutka missile launcher and guidance equipment appear merged into one case, with the oversized sight column fixed to the missile's launch suitcase rather than a clearly separate control box.
issues.fix: Rebuild the visible equipment as a period-correct 9M14 Malyutka launcher suitcase plus separate guidance control box and periscope sight, based on the prop reference.

issues.description: A translucent ridged screw-cap bottle at the lower-right edge reads as a prohibited modern plastic bottle.
issues.fix: Replace it with a period-correct 1973 military metal canteen in an appropriate canvas cover.

issues.description: The desert and smoke retain more detail than expected from the specified shallow-depth 85mm portrait treatment.
issues.fix: Use shallower depth of field so the eye, lips and sight are sharp while the smoke and desert fall softly out of focus.

references: real reference photo of prop PRP-0003 9M14 Malyutka (AT-3 Sagger) anti-tank missile

These flaws would compromise the ensuing animation.

issues.description: A large explosion is already erupting at frame left, prematurely revealing the event that is supposed to happen seconds later in the clip.
issues.fix: Re-render the first frame before the impact, leaving only existing battlefield smoke in the distance; reserve the old-pit eruption for the later animation.

issues.description: No clear new pit or route between two pits is visible, so the team's immediate objective is not readable.
issues.fix: Include a shallow but clearly recognizable destination fighting pit ahead of the runners and an abandoned pit behind them, while retaining the otherwise flat terrain.

issues.description: The foreground gunner's launcher has an incorrect, generated silhouette and does not convincingly depict a loaded 1973 RPG-7.
issues.fix: Render a correctly proportioned RPG-7 with its recognizable tube, rear venturi, grips, sights and PG-7 projectile, carried securely across the chest while running.

issues.description: The rear-right commando wears a beige head covering, contrary to the specified bare-headed appearance of the Egyptian Sa'iqa team.
issues.fix: Make the rear-right commando bare-headed with short black hair.

issues.description: The uniforms are dusty but do not strongly show the specified torn, blackened and sweat-soaked wear state.
issues.fix: Add restrained tears, sweat-darkening and smoke-blackening to the uniforms without adding wounds or gore.

issues.description: The prominent rifles do not have a convincing full-length FN FAL profile and instead resemble short AR/M16-pattern or generic generated weapons.

items.summary: The frame has convincing desert smoke and broadly natural anatomy, but it misses the designed action and lead casting. issues.description: C-05 is not shouting over his shoulder: his mouth is closed and his attention is directed sideways while holding the rifle across his chest.
issues.fix: Re-render him with his body in a firing kneel, the rifle properly shouldered, and his head turned over his shoulder with his mouth open in a forceful shout.

issues.description: The specified low sand berm is missing, leaving the sergeant exposed beside the road rather than kneeling behind cover.

issues.description: The visible lead has a different complexion, facial structure, beard, nose, eyes and jaw from ACT-0013.

issues.description: The rifle is not the required 1973 Egyptian AKM and is not shouldered correctly. It has black synthetic-looking furniture, an incorrect or malformed magazine area, and no firing cheek weld.
issues.fix: Replace it with a mechanically accurate AKM featuring a fixed wooden stock, wooden handguards and curved steel magazine; seat the butt firmly in the shoulder with the firing hand on the pistol grip and support hand beneath the fore-end.

issues.description: The load-bearing equipment does not clearly resemble the specified Soviet-pattern canvas AK magazine rig, and the uniform lacks the clearly defined two-pocket field-jacket construction.
issues.fix: Use an accurate 1973 Egyptian sand-khaki field uniform and Soviet-pattern canvas webbing sized for curved AKM magazines.

issues.description: The clothing and face are comparatively clean and intact rather than torn, smoke-blackened, dust-streaked and sweat-soaked.
issues.fix: Add restrained tears, soot, dust streaking and sweat-darkened fabric without adding blood or wounds.

issues.description: The white marking-tape reel is not evident, while the object behind the shoulder only ambiguously reads as the mine probe.
issues.fix: Make the steel mine probe and white marking-tape reel clearly identifiable and securely strapped to his back.

issues.description: C-05's mouth is closed, so the frame does not show him shouting a direction over his shoulder as designed.
issues.fix: Render him in the same three-quarter head turn with his mouth naturally open mid-shout and appropriate facial tension.

issues.description: The AK is carried low across his torso rather than seated into the shoulder in a firing position; the required fixed wooden stock is not visibly established.
issues.fix: Give him a clearly identifiable fixed-stock AKM with the wooden butt firmly seated in his shoulder, firing hand on the pistol grip and support hand securely under the fore-end.

issues.description: The equipment strapped vertically behind his right shoulder is bulky and mechanically ambiguous; the circular reel contains no clearly visible white marking tape, and the adjacent object does not read as the specified steel mine probe.

issues.description: The uniform is dusty and sweat-marked but not substantially torn or blackened by smoke, and there is no distinct burst of freshly kicked-up dust around the kneeling soldier.

items.edit_instruction: Replace the exposed bottle at his left hip with an opaque 1973 Egyptian/Soviet-pattern canteen in a dusty khaki canvas carrier. items.edit_instruction: Remove the steel rod, loop handle and dark carrying strap or harness, leaving only the white marking-tape reel and its loose wind-lifted end resting naturally on uninterrupted sand. Keep everything else exactly the same.

The required small left-eyebrow nick is not clearly present. The head is also turned slightly rather than squarely facing the camera.

issues.description: The subject has thick, curved eyebrows instead of the designed thin, straight eyebrows, and the required subtle healed nick in his left eyebrow is not clearly represented.
issues.fix: Redo the face with thin straight eyebrows and a small, barely visible healed nick interrupting a few hairs in the subject's left eyebrow.

issues.description: Visible moustache shadow and concentrated chin/goatee hair contradict the explicitly clean-shaven actor design.
issues.fix: Make the face clean-shaven while retaining natural skin pores and texture.

issues.description: The head is turned slightly into a three-quarter angle rather than facing the camera squarely as required for a model-training anchor.
issues.fix: Align the head directly toward the camera while retaining direct eye contact and a neutral expression.

items.summary: The portrait is clean, photorealistic, correctly vertical, front-facing and evenly lit, but the actor reads as elderly—approximately late 60s or older—rather than an apparent age of 45. The exposed frontal hair and darker, fuller eyebrows also diverge from the design. Because this image defines the actor for the series, the age mismatch is not acceptable for an anchor.

issues.description: The centered woman appears elderly, roughly late 60s or older, rather than the specified apparent age of 45. The very hollow cheeks, facial volume loss and overall ageing go beyond a weathered mid-40s face.
issues.fix: Redo only the face as the same Egyptian woman at apparent age 45, retaining exceptionally deep work-and-sun wrinkles while restoring credible mid-40s facial volume and structure.

issues.description: The eyebrows are darker and fuller than the designed sparse light eyebrows.
issues.fix: Make both eyebrows sparse and lighter while preserving their natural texture.

issues.description: A broad section of dark frontal hair is visible beneath the scarf although the design says her hair is always covered.
issues.fix: Extend the under-scarf or headscarf forward to cover the visible hair naturally.

items.summary: The portrait is photorealistic, clean, naturally proportioned, and correctly framed in vertical 3:4. However, it does not precisely establish the designed actor: he appears closer to 60–65 than 50, and his dense, full swept-back hair lacks the specified receding hairline. The lighting is also somewhat more directional than the requested soft, even anchor lighting. Because this image defines the face model for the entire series, the identity mismatch is significant.

issues.description: The actor appears roughly a decade or more older than the designed apparent age of 50, with pronounced aging around the forehead, eyes, cheeks, and mouth.
issues.fix: Redo the face at an apparent age of about 50 while retaining the heavy, solid build, broad jowly structure, grey mustache, thick eyebrows, bulbous nose, and light olive complexion.

issues.description: The dense, full hairline does not match the specified receding grey hair combed straight back.
issues.fix: Give the actor a clearly receding front hairline and thinner grey hair combed straight back, without changing the specified facial structure.

issues.description: The portrait lighting is somewhat directional across the face rather than evenly balanced for a casting anchor.
issues.fix: Use softer, more even frontal illumination while preserving natural modeling and skin texture.

issues.description: The anchor appears materially younger than the designed late-30s actor and lacks the specified crow's feet and mature eye-area character.

issues.description: The mustache is dense and medium-thick rather than the designed thin mustache.

items.summary: The frame is a coherent photorealistic image, but it depicts a World War II-era Western Allied patrol with steel helmets, period-inappropriate weapons and an armored vehicle in a European stone town. It does not represent the Egyptian 183rd Sa'iqa Battalion, October 1973, the Tina Plain, Romani road, a Delta village or Cairo, and the supplied shot design contains no usable visual specification for “The order.”

issues.description: The rendered subject is an unrelated WWII-style Western military patrol, while the production concerns Egyptian commandos during the October 1973 war. The shot’s actual visual design fields are blank.
issues.fix: Write a complete shot design for beat “The order,” specifying who gives or receives the order, the number and placement of soldiers, setting, time of day, shot size, camera angle and required action, then regenerate.

issues.description: All prominent uniforms, M1-style helmets, webbing, weapons and the armored vehicle belong to a WWII visual language rather than 1973 Egyptian Sa'iqa forces.
issues.fix: Replace the entire military presentation with bare-headed Egyptian commandos in 1970s Egyptian field uniforms and Soviet-pattern webbing, using only correct 1973 insignia and equipment.

issues.description: The visible small arms and vehicle are not among the specified Egyptian 1973 equipment, and none of the required AKM/RPG-7/Malyutka/RKG-3 or mine loads appears.
issues.fix: Specify and render only the weapons and loads required for this beat, with fixed-stock wooden AKMs and any other named equipment carried correctly.

issues.description: The European stone town is outside every permitted production location for this story.
issues.fix: Set the shot in the Tina Plain salt marsh, on the Romani road, in the specified Menoufia village or in the blacked-out Cairo flat, according to the intended scene.

issues.description: The soldiers do not read as Egyptian men and their presentation substitutes a Western WWII force for the specified Egyptian unit.
issues.fix: Cast Egyptian-looking men and follow the production’s Egyptian uniform, grooming and insignia rules.
